lines.text: THE Lord rose up indeed The saviour rose again He rose victorious Over all the powers of hell In their great fear, the guards trembled Fell down and became dead men.
Behold the angel host Assembled together To list to His command And also to worship They came with Joy and they did fly. From heaven in the morn to the tomb.
Back to heaven they did fly With glad tidings of joy List to their sweet singing Back to heaven As they flew Their song was this, Jesus who died Is ris'n again, is ris'n today.
All ye that are redeemed Join In the glad refrain Let It echo around To all the earth abroad Shout and sing for Jesus who died Is ris‘n again, shall die no more.
All hail, our Saviour, King Who bought us with His blood Praise who art ris‘n again We rise with Thee and reign with Thee Will Thee ever in heaven above.
